title: PISA: Prioritized Invariant Subgraph Aggregation for Out-of-Distribution Generalization on Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2511.22435v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Invariant learning on graphs aims to build predictors that rely on causal substructures rather than on environment-specific shortcuts. Current methods extract either a single invariant subgraph (CIGA) or, more recently, a set of diverse invariant subgraphs (SuGAr). We observe that the second half of the multi-subgraph pipeline, "how the extracted subgraphs are combined" has gone essentially unexamined; existing methods average branch predictions uniformly or select one greedily. We show that this is precisely where accuracy is lost. A minimum-variance combination argument establishes that uniform averaging is optimal only when every branch carries the same total error covariance with the ensemble---a knife edge balance that second order exchangeability guarantees and that the diversity regularizer used to obtain multiple subgraphs is explicitly designed to break. We then show that invariance is closed under post composition; because

translated_title: PISA：面向图分布外泛化的优先级不变子图聚合
translated_abstract: 图上的不变学习旨在构建依赖于因果子结构而非环境特定捷径的预测器。现有方法要么提取单一不变子图（CIGA），要么提取一组多样化的不变子图（SuGAr）。我们观察到，多子图流程的后半部分——即“如何组合所提取的子图”——基本上未被研究过；现有方法要么对分支预测进行均匀平均，要么贪心地选择其中一个子图。我们证明这正是准确率损失之所在。基于最小方差组合的论证表明，只有当每个分支与集成模型携带相同的总误差协方差时，均匀平均才是最优的——这是一种临界平衡状态，二阶可交换性保证了这种平衡，而用于获取多个子图的多样性正则化器却恰恰明确地旨在打破这种平衡。我们随后证明，不变性在事后组合下是封闭的；因为……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PISA方法，揭示了多子图不变学习中均匀平均聚合仅在各分支误差协方差相同时才最优的缺陷，并通过对多样化不变子图进行优先级加权聚合来提升图上的分布外泛化性能。
en_tdlr: PISA shows that uniform averaging of invariant subgraph branches is optimal only when their error covariances are identical—a balance broken by diversity regularizers—and proposes prioritized aggregation of diverse invariant subgraphs to improve out-of-distribution generalization on graphs.
